verdict.rationale: Smithery's archived docs described Uplink, which exposed an MCP server running on any machine as a regular Smithery connection without hosting it. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Connect service and connection management stopped working on October 31, 2026, and Smithery now remains only a public, non-proxied registry. The product therefore no longer offers managed remote connections for local servers, so the documented capability is discontinued rather than delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bridge a locally running MCP server into the platform as a managed remote connection without deploying it
